title.title: Title
title.description: Short report title: one defect, one root cause.

description.title: Description
description.description: What is wrong, where, and what you were doing when you saw it.

actual.title: Actual
actual.description: The behaviour you observed, with the exact output.

repro_command.title: Reproduction command
repro_command.description: One line that reproduces the issue. Use repro_steps for anything longer.

repro_steps.title: Reproduction steps
repro_steps.description: Several steps, when one command cannot hold them.

suggested_fix.title: Suggested fix
suggested_fix.description: Your proposed fix. Keep expected to the behaviour.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: Ordering-only label; it never changes whether a report is accepted.

category.title: Category
category.description: Ordering-only free-text label, at most 48 characters.

refs.title: References
refs.description: A spec, criterion, commit or issue this report relates to.

dimensions.question: Can someone else reproduce this from the report alone, and what did you run to see it?
Is this one defect with one root cause that can be closed on its own, or several reports bundled together?
